verses.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਵਾਮਿ ਕਾਜ ਲਾਗਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਤ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੈਸੇ  ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਿਰਖ ਸਨੇਹ ਉਪਜਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: savaiaam kaaj laag sevaa karat sevak jaise  narapat nirakh saneh upajaavahee ||

en.bdb: Just as a worker serves the king whole-heartedly and the king feels happy to see him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪੂਤ ਚੋਚਲਾ ਕਰਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਦਿਮਾਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਢਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise poot chochalaa karat pitaa bidhimaan dhekh dhekh sun sun aana(n)dh baddaavahee ||

en.bdb: Just as a son shows his childish pranks to his father, seeing and hearing these father pampers and cuddles him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਕਸਾਲਾ ਮਧਿ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਪਰੋਸੈ ਨਾਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਖਾਤ ਪਿਆਰ ਕੈ ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise paakasaalaa madh bi(n)jan parosai naar pat khaat piaar kai param sukh paavahee ||

en.bdb: Just as a wife serves the food fondly that she had prepared so lovingly in the kitchen, her husband eats it with pleasure and that pleases her immensely.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਨਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਤਾ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਰੀਝਿ ਗਾਇਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੀ ॥੫੬੬॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur sabadh sunat srotaa saavadhaan gaavai reejh gain sahaj liv laavahee ||566||

en.bdb: Similarly, the devoted followers of the Guru hear the divine words of the Guru with rapt attention. Then the singer of these hymns also sing with deep emotion and love that helps both the listeners and the singers absorb their mind in the essence of Guru's words.  (566)
